Bill.BriefDescription: Limiting the powers of homeowners' associations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to homeowners' associations; and adding a newsection to chapter 64.38 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 64.38 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The governing documents may not prohibit the outdoor display ofpolitical yard signs by an owner or resident on the owner's orresident's property before any primary or general election. Thegoverning documents may include reasonable rules and regulationsregarding the placement and manner of display of political yard signs. (2) This section applies retroactively to any governing documentsin effect on the effective date of this section. Any provision in agoverning document in effect on the effective date of this section thatis inconsistent with this section is void and unenforceable.
